lines.en: label yukispring2:
scene yukirikavisit1
: {i}Hah...{/i}Probably. Guess that could’ve gone a little better now that you mention it.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}大概吧。你这么一说，刚才好像本来可以收得更体面一点。

lines.en: : Technically, it still went probably five times better than I expected it to.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，它比我预想的好了大概五倍。

lines.en: : Yeah, but it still could have gone {i}better.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是，不过本来还是可以{i}更好{/i}的。

lines.en: : I’ll agree that it probably would have been nice to not watch you spit all over the only real friend you’ve got.
lines.zh: : 我同意，如果不用看着你往自己唯一真正的朋友身上泼脏水，大概会好受些。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit2
: Still got you, don’t I? Take it you’re the type who’d {i}want{/i} me to spit on him, though.
lines.zh: : 我不还有你吗？不过我看你是那种{i}会想{/i}让我往他身上吐口水的类型。

lines.en: : Maybe under the right circumstances. But if you were to do that right now, I’d probably just want to take a shower.
lines.zh: : 也许在合适的情境下吧。但你要是现在这么干，我大概只想洗个澡。

lines.en: : Ya mean you aint already feelin’ grimy as shit watchin’ an addict do what an addict does best?
lines.zh: : 你是说，看着一个瘾君子做瘾君子最擅长的事，你还没觉得恶心得要死？

lines.en: : What’s that? Relapse?
lines.zh: : 那是什么？复吸？

lines.en: : {i}Lie.{/i}
scene yukirikavisit3
: Kinda funny, actually. How easy that is. But I’ve always wondered if it’s for selfish reasons or just because dealin’ with confrontation kinda sucks.
lines.zh: : 其实挺好笑的。这事儿居然这么容易。不过我一直好奇，人撒谎到底是出于自私，还是单纯因为面对冲突太他妈难受了。

lines.en: : It’s selfish no matter what way you look at it when you need to trample over other people’s feelings to get to where you are now.
lines.zh: : 不管从哪个角度看都是自私——当你得踩着别人的感受，才能走到现在这个位置。

lines.en: : Yeah well, they ain’t gonna have to be trampled much longer at this rate.
lines.zh: : 哼，照这个速度，他们也用不了多久就不用被踩了。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit4
: So...you {i}are{/i} using drugs again?
lines.zh: : 那么……你又{i}在{/i}嗑药了？

lines.en: : Maybe. Maybe not. I can say whatever I want and you won’t know what to believe.
lines.zh: : 也许是，也许不是。我想说什么都行，你也不知道该信哪句。

lines.en: : If you are, I’d like to extend my gratitude. I’m very thankful that you’d trust me to be the only one burdened by this knowledge instead of someone who could actually help.
lines.zh: : 如果你在嗑，那我得谢谢你。非常感谢你愿意把这份重担只交给我一个人扛，而不是交给某个真正帮得上忙的人。

lines.en: : See, that’s the part you ain’t gettin’. This ain’t the kinda shit other people can help with.
lines.zh: : 你看，这就是你没懂的地方。这种事不是别人帮得了的。

lines.en: : It’s a constant battle against yourself and even when you think you’re {i}safe,{/i} you ain’t. Takes just one thought. One mistake. Then you’re right back where you started.
lines.zh: : 这是跟自己打的持久战，就算你以为自己{i}安全{/i}了，也并不安全。只需要一个念头。一次失误。然后你就又回到原点了。

lines.en: : And what was that thought this time?
lines.zh: : 那这一次是什么念头？

lines.en: : Was there even a thought at all? Or do you just despise this world for letting you breathe for a change?
lines.zh: : 还是说根本就没有什么念头？又或者你只是恨这个世界，恨它终于让你喘了口气？

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit5
: What’s it like for you?
lines.zh: : 那你是什么感觉？

lines.en: : What’s {i}what{/i} like for me?
lines.zh: : 我{i}什么{/i}感觉？

lines.en: : Hatin’ yourself without a clear-cut reason to do that. Cause you’re in the same fuckin’ boat. Just nobody ever blames you when the ship starts sinkin’.
lines.zh: : 毫无明确理由地恨自己是什么感觉。因为你跟他妈我坐在同一条船上。只不过船开始沉的时候，从来没人怪你。

lines.en: : Just wanna know if it’d be any easier to forgive myself for any of this shit if there wasn’t such a fuckin’ obvious problem.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道，如果我没有这么一个他妈明显的问题，原谅自己做过这些破事会不会更容易一点。

lines.en: : I doubt it, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑不会，Yuki。

lines.en: : Yeah...figures.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也是。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit6
: You know...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……

lines.en: : You might be the first guy I’ve ever actually had feelings for.
lines.zh: : 你可能是我第一个真正动过心的男人。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit7
: And you pick {i}now{/i} to tell me that?
lines.zh: : 你挑{i}这个时候{/i}告诉我？

lines.en: : Better now than never, right?
lines.zh: : 总比永远不说强吧？

lines.en: : Yuki-
lines.zh: : Yuki——

lines.en: : I ain’t expecting much to come of it. And I already told you I wouldn’t wanna have to drag Sara into any of that shit since she likes you way more than me.
lines.zh: : 我也没指望能有什么结果。而且我说过了，我不想把 Sara 也拖进这些破事里，毕竟她喜欢你比喜欢我多得多。

lines.en: : Just figured...you know. Ain’t worth keepin’ it to myself anymore. And if I’m gonna give you one reason to think about me, might as well keep pilin’ ‘em on.
lines.zh: : 就是觉得……你知道的。不值得再憋着了。既然要给你一个想我的理由，那不如多堆几个上去。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit8
: It’s weird how this shit works, huh? You ain’t my type at all. Feels like I’m rockin’ the cradle a bit too hard.
lines.zh: : 这种事真奇怪，对吧？你完全不是我喜欢的类型。感觉像是我把摇篮摇得太狠了点。

lines.en: : So it’s {i}my{/i} fault you-
lines.zh: : 所以你变成这样都怪{i}我{/i}——

lines.en: : Pfft. Don’t give yourself {i}that{/i} much credit. Just because I think about you sometimes doesn’t mean I’d throw my life away if you don’t look at me enough.
lines.zh: : 啧。别{i}太{/i}抬举自己了。我只是偶尔会想你，不代表你要是看我不够多，我就会把自己的命扔掉。

lines.en: : This happened because I’m weak. None of y’all had shit to do with it.
lines.zh: : 会发生这种事，是因为我软弱。跟你们谁都没关系。

lines.en: : Just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : Some bad decisions catchin’ up to me. That’s all that’s goin’ on here.
lines.zh: : 只是几个糟糕的决定追上来跟我算账了。事情就是这样。

lines.en: scene black
: And on that note, looks like Sara’s had enough time to “cool off.” Place your bets now on whether or not you’ll ever see me around the bar again.
lines.zh: : 说到这个，看来 Sara 「冷静」的时间够久了。现在下注吧，赌你以后还会不会在酒吧见到我。

lines.en: I sigh to myself and move toward the door as Yuki sinks deeper into her couch.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，朝门口走去，Yuki 则往沙发里陷得更深。

lines.en: But as I attempt to imagine how the smell of a rotting corpse would blend into the cacophony of other unpleasant aromas in here, I’m hit by a truck.
lines.zh: 可就在我试图想象一具腐尸的臭味会怎么混进这里其他难闻气味的合奏时，我被一辆卡车撞上了。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit9
Because this isn’t Sara at all. This is someone I plucked off the street and dragged into a funeral.
lines.zh: 因为门口站着的根本不是 Sara。是我从街上随手捡来、硬拖去一场葬礼的人。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Oh.
: Uhh...
scene yukirikavisit10
: Am I interrupting something here?
lines.zh: : 我打扰到什么了吗？

lines.en: : Just the world’s worst intervention. Sup?
lines.zh: : 只是世上最烂的一次干预。咋啦？

lines.en: : You are naked.
lines.zh: : 你没穿衣服。

lines.en: : Not all the way.
lines.zh: : 也没全裸。

lines.en: : This pleases me.
lines.zh: : 这让我很满意。

lines.en: : ...What?
scene yukirikavisit11
: Nothing. I speak my thoughts out loud when I feel too many things at once sometimes. Please ignore them.
lines.zh: : 没什么。我有时情绪太多，会把脑子里的想法说出声。请忽略它们。

lines.en: : So that’s where Rin gets it from.
lines.zh: : 原来 Rin 是从你这儿遗传的。

lines.en: : The fuck are you holdin’? Also, the fuck are you doin’ here? Forget which room is yours?
lines.zh: : 你他妈手里拿着什么？还有，你他妈来这儿干嘛？忘了哪间是你家了？

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit12
: Oh! No! Uhh...These are...I made...
lines.zh: : 哦！不是！呃……这些是……我做的……

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit13
: They’re...Halloween cookies. I just...made too many and figured you might want some of the extras.
lines.zh: : 是……万圣节饼干。我……做太多了，想着你也许想要些多余的。

lines.en: : You made these specifically {i}for{/i} her, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你是特意{i}为{/i}她做的吧？

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit14
: {i}Shh!{/i}
: Heh...Halloween, huh? Figures. You really made those for me?
lines.zh: : 呵……万圣节啊。倒也合理。你真是为我做的？

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit15
: Yes! I mean...no? Only if you wanted me to make them for you. But the point is that I made cookies and cookies now exist because of me. Please put them in your mouth and be happy.
lines.zh: : 是！我是说……不是？只有你想让我为你做的时候才算吧。但重点是，我做了饼干，饼干因为我而存在了。请把它们放进嘴里，然后幸福吧。

lines.en: : Sure. Just leave ‘em on the table and I’ll have ‘em for dinner when I’m not busy destroying everything.
lines.zh: : 行。放桌上吧，等我不再忙着毁掉一切的时候，就拿它们当晚饭。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit16
: Well, actually...I...
lines.zh: : 嗯，其实……我……

lines.en: : I was kind of hoping we could...eat them together and like...become friends? If that’s not weird? It’s probably weird.
lines.zh: : 我有点希望我们能……一起吃，然后……变成朋友？如果这不奇怪的话？大概挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : It’s just...not really a great time, Rika.
lines.zh: : 只是……现在实在不太是时候，Rika。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit17
: {i}Stop fucking all of my neighbors!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别再搞我所有邻居了！{/i}

lines.en: : I’m not fucking either of your neighbors. And you {i}want{/i} me to fuck one of them.
lines.zh: : 我可没搞你任何一个邻居。而且你还{i}想{/i}让我搞其中一个呢。

lines.en: : {i}Not this one! I’m trying to be cute and I can’t because you’re over here macking it with my crush! Now, beat it or it’ll have to be a threesome!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别搞这一个！我正想装可爱呢，结果你在这儿跟我暗恋的对象亲热！快滚，不然就得变成三人行了！{/i}

lines.en: : Oh no. Whatever will I do if something like that occurs?
lines.zh: : 哦不。要是真变成那样，我可怎么办啊？

lines.en: : Can you two stop fuckin’ whispering and just bring the damn cookies over here? I ain’t eaten {i}shit{/i} all day.
lines.zh: : 你俩能不能别他妈咬耳朵了，把那该死的饼干拿过来？我一整天{i}什么都{/i}没吃。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit18
: Coming! Hahah!
lines.zh: : 来了！哈哈哈！

lines.en: scene black
scene yukirikavisit19
The three of us sit down at the table, causing an entire liquor store worth of beer cans to fall over as our legs take their places beneath it.
lines.zh: 我们三个在桌边坐下，随着腿伸到桌下，足有一整家酒馆那么多的啤酒罐被撞倒。

lines.en: Rika doesn’t seem to pay any mind to it though, as she’s currently entranced by Yuki for...whatever reason. Probably the “cool” factor.
lines.zh: 不过 Rika 似乎毫不在意，因为她此刻正被 Yuki 迷住了——出于某种原因。大概是那股「酷」劲儿。

lines.en: But I wonder if her feelings would change upon finding out that Yuki isn’t exactly as “cool” as she looks. And I worry that letting Rika fall further might mean having to learn who she really is.
lines.zh: 但我在想，要是她发现 Yuki 并不像看上去那么「酷」，她的感觉会不会变。而我担心，让 Rika 陷得更深，可能意味着她迟早会认清 Yuki 究竟是谁。

lines.en: : So, uh...sorry. What’s your name again?
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……抱歉。你叫什么来着？

lines.en: : Rika. I’m Rin’s mom.
lines.zh: : Rika。我是 Rin 的妈妈。

lines.en: : And...who is Rin?
lines.zh: : 那……Rin 是谁？

lines.en: : My daughter. She’s adorable. Do you like Mexican food?
lines.zh: : 我女儿。她超可爱的。你喜欢墨西哥菜吗？

lines.en: : Uh...sure. It’s fine, I guess.
lines.zh: : 呃……喜欢吧。还行，我觉得。

lines.en: : We have so much in common.
lines.zh: : 我们真是有很多共同点。

lines.en: : Did you really turn a straight girl into a lesbian? Because you’re just as awkward when it comes to flirting as your daughter.
lines.zh: : 你真的把一个直女掰弯了吗？因为你调情时的笨拙程度跟你女儿一模一样。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit20
: {i}I’m seriously going to kill you!~{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我真的要杀了你！~{/i}

lines.en: : Flirting?
lines.zh: : 调情？

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit19
: Nope! Not me. Just sharing some sugary treats with neighbors in preparation for everyone’s favorite holiday.
lines.zh: : 不！不是我。只是在为所有人最喜欢的节日做准备，跟邻居们分享点甜食而已。

lines.en: : Not mine. Halloween ain’t exactly full of happy memories for me.
lines.zh: : 不是我的。万圣节对我来说可没什么美好回忆。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit21
: What? Really? How come?
lines.zh: : 什么？真的吗？为什么？

lines.en: : It’s her daughter’s birthday.
lines.zh: : 那天是她女儿的生日。

lines.en: : Shouldn’t that make it even better then?
lines.zh: : 那不是应该更好吗？

lines.en: : Could’ve if I never ran out on her. Now, all it really does is remind me of all the birthdays she had to spend alone.
lines.zh: : 要是我从没抛下她，也许会。而现在，它唯一的作用就是提醒我，她有多少个生日是一个人过的。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit22
: O...Oh. Well...I’m sure you had your reasons!
lines.zh: : 哦……哦。嗯……我相信你当时有自己的苦衷！

lines.en: : Drugs and Yakuza shit. Mostly drugs.
lines.zh: : 毒品和黑帮那些破事。主要是毒品。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit23
: Yeah. Thanks for the cookies, though.
lines.zh: : 嗯。不过还是谢谢你的饼干。

lines.en: Update: It did not take very long for Rika to find out who Yuki really is.
lines.zh: 更新：Rika 认清 Yuki 到底是谁，并没有花太长时间。

lines.en: : You, uhh...
: Are you still involved in that kind of stuff?
lines.zh: : 你现在还在碰那些东西吗？

lines.en: : You ain’t a cop, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会是警察吧？

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit24
: Me? No. I’ve actually been arrested before, so...I’m not sure they’d even let {i}me{/i} be one if I wanted to. I just...well, you know. That stuff is dangerous. {i}Both{/i} of those things.
lines.zh: : 我？不是。我以前还真被逮捕过，所以……就算我想当，我都不确定他们会不会让{i}我{/i}当。我只是……嗯，你知道的。那些东西很危险。{i}那两样都{/i}危险。

lines.en: : The Yakuza’s only dangerous if you get yourself involved with ‘em. They rarely fuck with anyone on the outside.
lines.zh: : 黑帮只有在你自己掺和进去的时候才危险。他们很少去招惹外人。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. But you {i}are{/i} involved with them. And the drugs-
lines.zh: : 嗯，是。可你{i}确实{/i}掺和进去了啊。而且毒品——

lines.en: : Is it a hobby of yours to come into people’s apartments and interrogate them?
lines.zh: : 跑到别人公寓里审问人家，是你的爱好吗？

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit25
: She just wants to be your friend, Yuki. Rika’s a good person.
lines.zh: : 她只是想跟你做朋友，Yuki。Rika 是个好人。

lines.en: : Then she probably shouldn’t be my friend. You saw earlier how well I do with “good people.”
lines.zh: : 那她大概就不该跟我做朋友。你刚才也看见了，我跟「好人」相处得有多好。

lines.en: : I was just...I have friends who used to do that stuff too. And one of them runs an NA group in the Urban District. Figured you just...might wanna-
lines.zh: : 我只是……我也有朋友以前干过那些事。其中一个在都市区开了一个戒毒互助会。想着你也许……会想——

lines.en: : The one that meets in the old expo center? Or the one that meets in the church?
lines.zh: : 是在旧会展中心聚的那个，还是在教堂聚的那个？

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit26
: The church! You already know about it, then?
lines.zh: : 教堂那个！那你早就知道了？

lines.en: : Yeah, they don’t like me over there. Granted, I was still probably your age when I last tried going, so shit might’ve changed by now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那边的人不喜欢我。不过话说回来，我上次去的时候大概还是你这个年纪，所以现在情况也许变了。

lines.en: : Rika is 42.
lines.zh: : Rika 今年 42。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit27
: What? This girl? Are you fucking kidding me?
lines.zh: : 什么？这个丫头？你他妈在开玩笑吧？

lines.en: : You can call me “Onee-san” if you want. In fact, please do. I insist.
lines.zh: : 你可以叫我「onee-san」。说真的，请这么叫我。我坚持。

lines.en: : How the fuck do you look so young if you’re older than me? That ain’t fair.
lines.zh: : 你比我大，怎么他妈看起来这么年轻？这不公平。

lines.en: : I imagine the part where she isn’t a drug addict might have something to do with it.
lines.zh: : 我想，她不是瘾君子这一点大概有点关系。

lines.en: : I exercise a lot. But also, yeah. I’ve never done any hard drugs. I used to grow pot when I was in my twenties, though. That was fun. And very illegal. Not why I was arrested, though.
lines.zh: : 我锻炼很多。而且，嗯，我从没碰过硬毒品。不过我二十几岁的时候种过大麻。那挺好玩的。而且非常违法。不过我被捕不是因为这个。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit28
: But, that said, you don’t look {i}that{/i} old. Your skin’s still nice. Maybe a little pale, sure. But you look soft. I want to touch you.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，你看着也没{i}那么{/i}老。皮肤还挺好的。确实有点苍白。但你摸起来应该很软。我想摸你。

lines.en: : Don’t.
scene yukirikavisit29
: Honestly, though? I feel like figuring out how to get rid of those dark circles will knock like ten years off the way you look. Maybe some more bleach too. Your hair looks kind of faded.
lines.zh: : 不过说真的？我觉得想办法把那黑眼圈去掉，能让你看起来年轻十岁。也许再漂一漂头发。你的发色看着有点褪了。

lines.en: : First an interrogation, now a makeover? Am I gonna have to find a new apartment or are you gonna learn how to back off a little?
lines.zh: : 先是审问，现在又改造？我是不是得换个新公寓，还是你能学着稍微退一步？

lines.en: : Hey, you asked this time. I’m just sharing my secrets with you.
lines.zh: : 嘿，这次是你问的。我只是跟你分享我的秘诀而已。

lines.en: : So if {i}you{/i} want to share some secrets with me. Like...oh, I don’t know, how likely you are to ever kiss a girl? That’d be cool. Like, I definitely wouldn’t tell anybody. Nope.
lines.zh: : 所以要是{i}你{/i}也想跟我分享点秘密的话。比如……哦，我不知道，你有多大可能会去亲一个女孩？那就太好了。比如，我绝对不会告诉任何人。绝对不。

lines.en: : You know what? Why don’t we go back to talkin’ about {i}less{/i} personal shit?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？我们还是聊点{i}不那么{/i}私人的破事吧？

lines.en: : Cause the {i}last{/i} fuckin’ thing I need is one more person to let down and you’re gettin’ way too close way too quickly.
lines.zh: : 因为我他妈{i}最不需要的{/i}，就是再多一个被我辜负的人，而你靠得太近、也太快了。

lines.en: : Well, what do you want to talk about instead? Because I figured the Halloween part of the conversation would take up least fifteen minutes and we never even got into that part.
lines.zh: : 那你想聊什么？我本来以为万圣节那部分至少能聊上十五分钟，结果我们根本没聊到那儿。

lines.en: : Beats me. How’d the two of {i}you guys{/i} meet anyway?
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。{i}你们俩{/i}到底是怎么认识的？

lines.en: : He walked in on me while I was wearing nothing but a towel.
lines.zh: : 我身上只围着一条毛巾的时候，他走了进来。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit30
: And you...became friends?
lines.zh: : 然后你们……就成了朋友？

lines.en: : I mean, yeah. It’s not like anything sexual happened.
lines.zh: : 嗯，对。又没有发生什么性方面的事。

lines.en: : It wasn’t until a little while later that she grabbed my penis.
lines.zh: : 直到过了一阵子，她才抓住我的阴茎。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit31
: I did it to protect my daughter.
lines.zh: : 我那么做是为了保护我女儿。

lines.en: : Well, I’m about ready to hit the sack now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我差不多该去睡了。

lines.en: : You don’t have to hit it. Just sorta firmly grasp it and you can get a feel for- oh, you’re tired.
lines.zh: : 不用「打」它。只要稍微用力握住，你就能摸出个——哦，你是困了。

lines.en: : Can’t really blame her since she was passed out drunk until just before you showed up. If she had it her way, we wouldn’t even be here right now.
lines.zh: : 也不能怪她，毕竟你出现之前她一直醉得不省人事。要是随她的意，我们现在根本不会在这儿。

lines.en: : As someone new to the world of alcohol, I’ve found it’s best to stop drinking {i}before{/i} you get to that part. So no one can take advantage of you and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 作为一个刚接触酒精世界的新人，我发现在到那一步{i}之前{/i}停下不喝是最好的。这样就不会有人趁机占你便宜什么的。

lines.en: : Probably best to not say things like that around Yuki.
lines.zh: : 在 Yuki 面前最好别说这种话。

lines.en: : Say what? I’m in kind of a trance right now and am only barely conscious of what I’m actually saying. It’s all just words.
lines.zh: : 说什么？我现在有点恍惚，几乎不知道自己到底在说什么。都只是词而已。

lines.en: : Rika, thanks for the cookies and shit. But I feel like you and I ain’t as...{i}compatible{/i} as you might’a thought. So I think it’d be cool if you just left or-
lines.zh: : Rika，谢谢你的饼干什么的。不过我觉得你和我没有你以为的那么……{i}合得来{/i}。所以你要是能直接走人，那就再好不过了，或者——

lines.en: : Can I see your tattoo?
lines.zh: : 我能看看你的纹身吗？

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit32
: Sorry. It’s just a nice piece and gives me an excuse for my skin to touch your skin.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。只是它很好看，而且给了我一个让我的皮肤碰到你的皮肤的理由。

lines.en: : {i}Fine.{/i} Just make it quick.
scene yukirikavisit33
: Yay!
: I’m surprised you’re even letting her with how annoyed you appear to be getting.
lines.zh: : 看你越来越烦的样子，我还挺意外你居然让她看。

lines.en: : Feels like a lost puppy wandered into my apartment and now I’ve gotta reluctantly feed it so it won’t fuckin’ die.
lines.zh: : 感觉像是有只走丢的小狗溜进了我家，现在我得勉为其难喂它，免得它他妈饿死。

lines.en: : That’s funny because that’s exactly how I’ve felt ever since my partner kicked me out to the curb!
lines.zh: : 真好笑，因为我被伴侣一脚踢到街边之后，一直是这种感觉！

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit34
: Some of the detail here is really nice. Where’d you get it done? Why didn’t you get it finished? Was it a money thing?
lines.zh: : 这里的有些细节真的很漂亮。你在哪儿纹的？为什么没纹完？是因为钱不够吗？

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit35
: Why you askin’? You got another friend who runs a tattoo shop somewhere?
lines.zh: : 你问这个干嘛？你还有个开纹身店的朋友？

lines.en: : Yes, actually. She’s the one who does all of my work. And I could probably get you a good deal if you-
lines.zh: : 还真有。我身上的都是她纹的。而且如果你——我大概能给你拿个好价钱。

lines.en: : That ain’t just a regular ass tattoo on my back, you know. It was the start of my horimono. And it ain’t filled in because I bailed on the Yakuza.
lines.zh: : 我背上那个可不是普通的纹身，你知道吗。那是我 horimono 的开头。没上完色，是因为我从黑帮那边逃了。

lines.en: : Now, it’s just a big fuckin’ dragon-shaped scar that reminds me of how I let myself get sucked into a life of crime rather than taking over a fuckin’ countryside candy shop.
lines.zh: : 现在，它只是一道他妈的龙形大疤，提醒着我当初是怎么让自己被吸进犯罪的泥潭，而不是去接管乡下一间该死的糖果店。

lines.en: : You like candy? I like candy. How about you cast aside your disdain for Halloween and we go trick or treating together?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢糖果？我也喜欢糖果。要不你抛开对万圣节的厌恶，我们一起去要糖？

lines.en: : Jesus Christ, you really are a puppy.
lines.zh: : 天啊，你还真是一只小狗。

lines.en: : You’re right. I am loyal and you can pet me as much you want. Additionally, I have a very impressive tongue and I love to lick.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我很忠诚，你想怎么摸我都行。另外，我的舌头非常了得，而且我很爱舔。

lines.en: : Oh, I get it now. You turned Rie into a lesbian through persistence.
lines.zh: : 哦，我明白了。你靠死缠烂打把 Rie 掰弯了。

lines.en: : Shush.
: I ain’t into chicks, Rika. It ain’t happenin’.
lines.zh: : 我对女人没兴趣，Rika。不可能的。

lines.en: : Can we be {i}friends,{/i} though?
lines.zh: : 那我们能做{i}朋友{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Why? You want to try and “fix” me? All the hints I’ve been droppin’ about who I really am not doin’ enough to push you away? You gonna literally make me drag you outta here?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你想试着「修好」我？我一直在暗示我到底是个什么样的人，难道还不够把你推开？你非得逼我真把你拖出去？

lines.en: : If I {i}do{/i} want to fix you, is that bad?
lines.zh: : 如果我{i}真的{/i}想修好你，那很糟糕吗？

lines.en: : Isn’t the whole point of a friendship or a relationship in general for two people to fill in gaps we can’t figure out how to fill on our own?
lines.zh: : 友谊、或者说任何一段关系的意义，不就是两个人去填补那些自己填不上的空缺吗？

lines.en: : You’re unhappy, aren’t you? Maybe I can help. And maybe you can help {i}me{/i} feel a little less alone too.
lines.zh: : 你不快乐，对吧？也许我能帮上忙。而也许你也能让{i}我{/i}不那么孤独一点。

lines.en: : Everyone I know already has someone. And so did I until a little while ago. But I {i}do{/i} feel kind of lost now. And you’re right next door. So maybe we-
lines.zh: : 我认识的每个人都有了另一半。直到不久前我也有。可我现在{i}确实{/i}有点迷失。而你就住在隔壁。所以也许我们——

lines.en: : Beat it.
scene yukirikavisit36
: There’s already one happy-go-lucky girl dead set on makin’ my life all exhausting and shit. I don’t need another one. Even if we {i}do{/i} have some shit in common.
lines.zh: : 已经有一个没心没肺的丫头铁了心要把我的生活搞得疲惫不堪了。我不需要再来一个。就算我们{i}确实{/i}有些共同点。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : {i}Beat it.{/i}
: I ain’t sayin’ it again.
lines.zh: : 我不会再说第二遍。

lines.en: scene black
: Sorry for...bothering you.
lines.zh: : 抱歉……打扰你了。

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit37
: Pretty soon, I’m going to be the only thing you have left to throw away.
lines.zh: : 用不了多久，我就会是你唯一还能扔掉的东西了。

lines.en: : I’m doing her a favor and you know it.
lines.zh: : 我这是在帮她，你心里清楚。

lines.en: : It’s bad enough that I already pulled Sara into this.
lines.zh: : 我已经把 Sara 拖进来了，这已经够糟了。

lines.en: : Is there {i}anything{/i} I can do for you, Yuki? Anything that will actually {i}help.{/i}
lines.zh: : 有{i}什么{/i}我能为你做的吗，Yuki？任何真正{i}帮得上忙{/i}的事。

lines.en: : Just take care of Yumi if some shit ever happens to me, aight?
lines.zh: : 要是我出了什么事，帮我照顾 Yumi，行吗？

lines.en: scene yukirikavisit38
: She needs somebody to look up to. And she’s gonna realize really fuckin’ soon that ain’t ever gonna be me no matter how much she tries to tell herself it will be.
lines.zh: : 她需要一个能仰望的人。而且她很快就会他妈意识到，不管她怎么说服自己，那个人都永远不会是我。

lines.en: : Are you going to try to get clean again?
lines.zh: : 你打算再试着戒一次吗？

lines.en: : I ain’t ever technically admitted I ain’t.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，我从来没承认过我没戒。

lines.en: : You’re right. But I’m also well-versed in hiding the truth from people. And we both know this goes deeper than just drinking.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。不过我也很擅长对人隐瞒真相。而且我们俩都知道，这事儿比单纯喝酒要深得多。

lines.en: : I care about you, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 我在乎你，Yuki。

lines.en: : I care about you too.
lines.zh: : 我也在乎你。

lines.en: scene black
: It’d be nice if that actually made a difference.
lines.zh: : 要是这真能改变什么就好了。

lines.en: I leave her apartment unsure of whether or not she’ll go to sleep the way she is now or if she’ll find something to help her.
lines.zh: 我离开她的公寓，不知道她会就这么睡着，还是会去找点什么帮自己。

lines.en: And when I make it home and sit down at my desk, I realize I’m the same way.
lines.zh: 而当我回到家、在书桌前坐下时，我意识到我也是一样的。

lines.en: Illuminated by the blue glow of my computer monitor, I unzip and unbutton my jeans, then slide them down until they’re in a ring around my ankles.
lines.zh: 在显示器幽蓝的光里，我拉开牛仔裤的拉链、解开扣子，把它们褪到脚踝，堆成一圈。

lines.en: I cum hard into a bundle of tissues as a silent video plays before me.
lines.zh: 一段静音的视频在我面前播放着，我狠狠地射进了一团纸巾里。

lines.en: They say it feels better than sex.
lines.zh: 据说这比做爱还爽。
